def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    dirty_spot_price = 104.17
    annual_coupon_rate = 0.02
    coupon_period_days = 180
    days_since_last_coupon = 30
    days_to_delivery = 90
    risk_free_rate = 0.0165
    conversion_factor = 0.7025
    day_count_basis = 360

    semiannual_coupon = annual_coupon_rate * 100 / 2
    days_until_coupon = coupon_period_days - days_since_last_coupon
    accrued_interest_at_delivery = (
        semiannual_coupon * days_to_delivery / coupon_period_days
    )

    # Carry the bond to delivery and subtract the coupon received before delivery
    bond_value_at_delivery = dirty_spot_price * (
        1 + risk_free_rate * days_to_delivery / day_count_basis
    )
    reinvested_coupon = semiannual_coupon * (
        1 + risk_free_rate * days_until_coupon / day_count_basis
    )

    forward_dirty_price = bond_value_at_delivery - reinvested_coupon

    # Invoice price = quoted futures price * conversion factor + accrued interest
    equilibrium_quoted_price = (
        forward_dirty_price - accrued_interest_at_delivery
    ) / conversion_factor

    # Return the answer rounded to three decimal places
    return round(equilibrium_quoted_price, 3)
